overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly specialized professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a combined total of 3,580 followers. His content focuses on computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, and academic hiring/opportunities, driving strong engagement relative to audience size across all three platforms.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of new publications, grant awards, and software tool updates like CooRnet v2.0.
Postdoctoral hiring calls and research opportunities for PhD students in computational social science.
Updates on upcoming presentations (e.g., #DisinfoConf2025) and insights on multi-platform research methods.

recommendations: Cross-post high-performing calls for PhD students and researchers to LinkedIn to maximize recruitment reach.
Increase posting frequency on Mastodon and LinkedIn to match the high engagement seen on Bluesky.
Incorporate more media assets, visual data summaries, or direct links to published papers to boost re-sharing across platforms.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest overall engagement rate (6.14% average), with publications and student research opportunities receiving significant repost activity.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a dedicated niche community in academic/social research (AoIR), generating high relative engagement on tool releases like CooRnet.
platformInsights.linkedin: Commands the largest total audience (1,850 followers) and highest absolute engagement per post (likes and comments), making it ideal for grant announcements and hiring.
